title: REVEALING AND REDUCING GENDER BIASES IN VISION AND LANGUAGE ASSISTANTS (VLAS)

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating distributional differences in the probability of answering 'Yes' to prompts asking whether an individual in an image possesses specific personality traits, work-related skills, or occupational aptitudes. The bias is measured by comparing these probabilities for male versus female images using a two-sample t-test on next-token prediction logits in a Visual Question Answering (VQA) format.
